basis: product correctness requirements + post-A1-H B2 distribution (precalibration-runtime-baseline-v4, 24 runs); thresholds are NOT derived to let any specific model pass (spec §26)

structural_correctness.measurement: structural hard gates on every holdout run; ANY violation fails acceptance outright

functional_case_outcome.weight: floor gate (§29) — guards against silent/empty agents scoring fake-high on semantic-only checks

observed_in_calibration.note: truth-semantic CaseOutcome (success/incomplete) is REPORTED but is not yet a gate: its truth expectations (coverage dimension records, specific disposition pairs) are not exercisable by the current production flow — documented as a future work item, not lowered here

semantic_correctness.weight: gate — evaluated only where semantic output exists; unavailable is recorded as unavailable, never as pass or 0-error

negative_case_safety.weight: case-level correctness gates (§30) — each is a hard per-case requirement

identity_trap.measurement: result semantic payload review (digest v4) + entity candidates

temporal_trap.unsupported_causal_escalation: 0 occurrences (temporal proximity must never become causal FACT)

misleading_context.note: the hypothesis must be verified against recorded evidence; refutation is the correct outcome

requirements.note: specialist floor set at 0.5: the recorded model limit is 0.29 (case-concentrated); the floor rejects a COLLAPSE (systematic failure), not the known limit
provider failures are retried/resumable; a series with more than 20% provider-terminal runs is INFRA_BLOCKED, not accepted

evaluation_protocol.holdout: corpus-agent-v0 holdout (SEALED, never run, hashes unchanged) — execution ONLY in an explicitly authorized B6 after this profile is frozen
evaluation_protocol.per_run: structural hard gates + CaseOutcome (reported) + digest v4 semantic review
evaluation_protocol.aggregation: per-axis verdicts; NO single total score (§27)

acceptance_verdict_rule.ACCEPTED: all zero-tolerance gates clean AND all floor gates met AND all case-level negative gates clean
acceptance_verdict_rule.REJECTED: any zero-tolerance violation, any floor miss, or any case-level negative-gate failure
acceptance_verdict_rule.INFRA_BLOCKED: provider/runtime terminal failures exceed the availability budget before the axes can be evaluated
